name: Filipino Beef Caldereta

components.name: Beef Caldereta

ingredients.name: Beef bottom round (or chuck), cut into 5 cm cubes
Large potatoes, peeled and cubed (~300 g each)
Large carrots, peeled and cubed (~150 g each)
Small bell peppers, green and red, cubed (~100 g each)

steps: Cut beef, potato and carrot into similarly sized chunks to cook evenly.
Brown the potato and carrot briefly in a little oil, remove them before they soften completely.
In the same pot soften onion and garlic, then sear the beef on all sides.
Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, water, chilli and seasoning. Cover and maintain a gentle simmer about 75–100 minutes or until beef is tender.
Add potato and carrot. Simmer until they are just cooked; stir in liver spread if using and melt the cheese into the sauce.
Finish with peppers and olives; simmer 3–5 minutes so peppers are not mushy.
Cool in shallow containers and portion. Serve with rice if desired; rice is not included in these macros.

Freezer: Potatoes and carrots soften after thawing.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
